title: New Physical AI course opens for spring registration
body: Hands-on robotics, teleoperation and AI agents, taught by ATR Lab researchers in the Department of Computer Science.
alt_text: Announcement from the Advanced Telerobotics Research Lab at Kent State University: a new Physical AI course opens for spring registration. Hands-on robotics, teleoperation and AI agents, taught by ATR Lab researchers in the Department of Computer Science. Details at atr.cs.kent.edu.
